content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text is grading a link collision between the defender's and challenger's chains, which is the situation K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"The phrase 'weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse' and the retirement of the stating-verse test: I weighed whether an underdetermination may rest on no verse naming the channel (forbidden verse-level absence) or must instead come from weighing the whole chains' footing (allowed chain-level judgment).","why":"The judge leaves the point open because no verse names whose body is the channel, which is the retired stating-verse/absence test rather than a chain-against-chain footing comparison."}
